h: Lewis Hamilton says he loves spending time with Kim Kardashian and Kanye West's children
p: The Formula 1 driver reportedly spoke at a press event about the time he spends with his girlfriend's children, saying he enjoys it. His remarks drew comment from fans of both the sport and celebrity gossip.
more: Hamilton has been linked with Kardashian in recent reports.
Neither star had issued a separate statement at the time of the reports.
